values.zh-CN:
设 X 是任意拓扑空间，Y 携带度量 d 诱导的拓扑。在连续映射空间 C(X,Y) 上，对每个紧集 K 定义 ρ_K(f,g)=sup_{x∈K} d(f(x),g(x))，空集上取零。该值有限，因为距离函数的连续紧像有界。紧开拓扑等于这些伪度量生成的紧集上一致收敛拓扑。

因此任意网 f_α 在紧开拓扑中收敛到 f，当且仅当对每个紧 K 与 ε>0，最终对所有 x∈K 均有 d(f_α(x),f(x))<ε。序列当然也满足此等价，但这不是以序列刻画任意拓扑。若 X 紧，取 K=X 即得到全域一致收敛拓扑；无需 X Hausdorff 或 Y 有界。
values.en:
Let X be arbitrary and let Y carry the topology induced by a metric d. On continuous maps put rho_K(f,g)=sup_{x in K} d(f(x),g(x)), with value zero for empty K. This is finite by compactness of the continuous image. The compact-open topology equals the topology generated by these pseudometrics.

Consequently a net converges in the compact-open topology exactly when it converges uniformly on every compact subset. This also applies to sequences but is not a claim that sequences determine arbitrary topologies. If X is compact, rho_X gives the uniform-convergence topology; neither Hausdorffness of X nor boundedness of Y is needed.
Metric targets and uniform convergence on compact sets
